name: How long does handrail installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does handrail installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of handrail installation depends on the project's scope and complexity. Simple, pre-fabricated handrails on a straight staircase might be installed within a day or two. More complex projects involving custom fabrication, multiple turns, or specialized materials like glass or intricate wrought iron can take several days to a week or more. The process typically includes site measurement, fabrication (if custom), preparation of the installation area, and finally, the installation and finishing touches. We provide a project timeline with our estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies: simple handrails can take 1-2 days, while custom or complex designs may require several days to over a week.
